result.title: The Staged Pandora's Box: Reservation Indices for Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization
result.summary: A staged search must decide which candidate to advance next and when to stop. Some observations only inform later decisions; others can be kept as results. We formulate these choices as a staged Pandora's box with a designated set of collectable stages. For independent finite-stage candidates with bounded readings and positive bounded own-history costs, an exact covered-call recursion gives the reservation index, the optimal value and the loss of every advance or stop; advancing an index-maximal candidate while its index exceeds the incumbent is optimal. The representation recovers classical single-stage search, nested inspection and the all-collectable Markov setting, and prices changes in the problem: enlarging the collectable set or lowering costs raises the value by an explicit covered-call overshoot. Resumption can be valuable even when future reward laws do not change, but has no value for deterministic readings. With information sharing across candidates, no rule using only their separate remaining-reading laws is universally optimal, and making an intermediate reading collectable can change which candidate is inspected first. Under a coherent joint path law with own-history costs, an approximate-planning bound controls the recomputed index's regret by changes in untouched candidates' local values; a common-component specialization bounds those changes through predictive total-variation dispersion. Exact finite-law experiments check the representation, the loss accounting and the bounds.

AI.brief_summary: 该文把「先推进哪个候选、何时停止」的分阶段搜索建模为带可收集阶段的 Pandora's box，在独立候选、有界读数与正的历史成本假设下，用 covered-call 递归导出 reservation index，给出推进与停止的最优规则及相应损失刻画，并讨论信息共享下的近似规划界。
AI.relevance_reason: 其索引型最优停止与观测成本定价，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本权衡、证据获取深度选择与停止决策提供形式化语言；但该文是纯理论多保真优化，与视觉状态表示的连接需核查。
